title: Artificial Intelligence for Music Generation, Arrangement and Orchestration
subtitle: A Systematic Review (2020–2025)
author: ZahraSadat Tahawori
university: IU International University of Applied Sciences

citations.apa: Tahawori, Z. (2026). Artificial intelligence for music generation, arrangement and orchestration: A systematic review (2020–2025) [Master's thesis, IU International University of Applied Sciences].

figures.title: Graphical abstract
figures.caption: Graphical abstract summarising the scope, method, analysis and key findings of the review.
figures.alt: Overview diagram showing the review scope, PRISMA screening, analyses and principal findings.

figures.title: Operational framework
figures.caption: Operational framework relating music generation, arrangement and orchestration across symbolic and audio domains.
figures.alt: Framework showing generation, arrangement and orchestration and their conditioning relationships in symbolic and audio domains.

figures.title: Review and synthesis workflow
figures.caption: Research workflow, showing the systematic-review stage and the subsequent synthesis stage.
figures.alt: Workflow from identification and screening to a 107-study corpus, trend synthesis and the 29-system pilot analysis.

figures.title: PRISMA 2020 flow diagram
figures.caption: PRISMA 2020 flow diagram of the review. The synthesis-stage selection of 29 methods is separate from PRISMA eligibility.
figures.alt: PRISMA flow: 4,521 records identified, 1,083 managed, 783 after deduplication, 145 full texts, 107 primary studies and 29 systems selected for additional analysis.

figures.title: Extended taxonomy
figures.caption: Extended taxonomy of AI music generation, arrangement and orchestration (2020–2025), extending Zhu et al. (2023).
figures.alt: Four-dimension taxonomy covering task, generative paradigm, conditioning modality and data representation.
